## Packages

[sRtr](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/sRtr) supplies the region geography and the transplant-center download, so the original scripts' own data files are no longer needed [@srtr_package]. sf handles the spatial data. ggplot2 draws the main version of each map, and tmap (version 4) draws the version with a Northeast inset. colorspace provides the `OrYel` palette the published maps used.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| eval: false
```

## Constants

- `map_crs` is the projection every layer is put in before plotting: NAD83 / Conus Albers (EPSG:5070), the projection sRtr stores its region data in.
- `northeast_regions` are the regions enlarged in the inset.
- `adult_center_exceptions` are the two centers with "Children" in their name that the original maps kept because they also transplant adults.
- There is no data path: each study's regional counts are written out in its own script.
